title: A Time-Aware Bag-of-Receptive-Fields for Interpretable Irregular Time Series Classification
abstract: arXiv:2609.39268v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Irregular time series, characterized by non-uniform sampling intervals, missing observations, and variable lengths, are ubiquitous in healthcare, mobility, and environmental monitoring, yet effective and interpretable classifiers for this setting are limited. Existing approaches often rely on imputation, which can obscure the temporal structure of the data, or require complex neural architectures that are opaque and difficult to explain. In this work, we extend the Bag-Of-Receptive-Fields (BORF), a fast, deterministic, and interpretable transform for time series, to the irregular setting. Our key contribution is a time-weighted normalization scheme in which each observation is weighted proportionally to its associated time delta, making pattern extraction sensitive to the actual temporal distribution of samples rather than only their index position. translated_title: 面向可解释不规则时间序列分类的时间感知感受野袋方法
translated_abstract: 不规则时间序列以非均匀采样间隔、缺失观测值和可变长度为特征，在医疗健康、移动出行和环境监测等领域无处不在，然而针对这种场景的有效且可解释的分类器仍然有限。现有方法通常依赖插补技术，这可能掩盖数据的时间结构，或者需要复杂且不透明、难以解释的神经架构。在这项工作中，我们将感受野袋（BORF）——一种快速、确定性且可解释的时间序列变换——扩展到不规则时间序列场景。我们的关键贡献是一种时间加权归一化方案，其中每个观测值按其对应的时间增量成比例地加权，使模式提取对样本的实际时间分布敏感，而不仅仅依赖于其索引位置。这需要推导出针对时间加权统计量的高效滑动窗口递推公式。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种时间加权归一化方案，将快速、确定性且可解释的感受野袋（BORF）变换扩展到不规则时间序列分类，使模式提取能够感知样本的实际时间分布而无需依赖插补或复杂的神经架构。
en_tdlr: This paper extends the fast, deterministic, and interpretable Bag-Of-Receptive-Fields (BORF) transform to irregular time series classification through a time-weighted normalization scheme that weights observations proportionally to their time deltas, enabling pattern extraction sensitive to the actual temporal distribution of samples without imputation or complex neural architectures.
